description: This file contains the implementation of a fraud scoring engine for an insurance fraud detection platform, including multiple evaluator functions for different fraud indicators, rules evaluation, signal saving, and scoring logic.

methods.name: _evaluate_high_amount
methods.description: Checks if the claim amount exceeds a configurable threshold.

methods.name: _evaluate_quick_filing
methods.description: Checks if the claim was filed suspiciously soon after the incident.

methods.name: _evaluate_frequency
methods.description: Checks if the policyholder has multiple claims within a specified time window.

methods.name: _evaluate_no_police_report
methods.description: Flags claims above a dollar amount that lack a police report.

methods.name: _evaluate_no_witnesses
methods.description: Flags high-value claims with zero witnesses.

methods.name: _evaluate_location
methods.description: Checks for suspicious location patterns using keywords.

methods.name: _evaluate_network
methods.description: Checks if the policyholder is linked to a known fraud network.

methods.name: _evaluate_duplicate_claimant
methods.description: Detects if the same claimant name appears on multiple recent claims.

methods.name: _evaluate_suspicious_description
methods.description: Flags claims whose description contains suspicious keywords.

methods.name: _evaluate_third_party_involvement
methods.description: Flags claims involving multiple third parties suggesting organized fraud.

methods.name: _evaluate_recent_policy
methods.description: Flags claims filed shortly after the start date of the policy.

methods.name: _evaluate_address_match
methods.description: Detects if the same claimant address appears on multiple claims.

methods.name: evaluate_claim
methods.description: Evaluates a claim against all active fraud rules and computes a fraud score.

methods.name: save_signals
methods.description: Persists fraud signal evaluations to the database.

methods.name: score_and_save
methods.description: Evaluates claim, saves signals, and updates the claim's fraud score and status.

methods.name: get_available_evaluators
methods.description: Returns all available named evaluator keys with descriptions.
